I can remove the event. Quick clarifying questions before I act (deleting calendar events is destructive):

1) Do you want me to delete the entire recurring "Design Critique" series, only the next Wednesday 16:00 occurrence, or this and all following occurrences? (Reply: "entire series" / "next occurrence" / "this and following".)  
2) Should I notify attendees (send cancellation notices) or just remove it from your calendar silently? (Reply: "notify" / "no notify".)

Once you confirm those two items I’ll locate the event and remove it.
